title: Initial-estimate email not sent to appraiser (Hachshara claims)
description: In claims against Hachshara Insurance, the appraiser does not receive the automated email requesting an initial damage estimate. Verify the trigger condition and dispatch flow for this insurer.

title: Slow claim-creation process
description: Opening a new claim is very slow. Move heavy processing to asynchronous background jobs and/or optimize performance so the user is never blocked.

title: Bafi import – filter by specific claim, digits-only claim number
description: The Bafi import must be filtered by the specific claim, and the claim number must be parsed as digits only.

title: Email auto-assignment and form placement in document sections
description: Automatic assignment of emails to "Incoming Correspondence" does not work correctly, and forms are not placed in their designated document sections.

title: Bafi session disconnects on every document pull
description: Every document pull from Bafi logs the user out of Bafi and forces a new login. The session must persist during and after the pull.

title: Incident-scene photos from WhatsApp filed under "Appraiser Photos"
description: Incident-scene photos that the customer sends via WhatsApp are still being filed under "Appraiser Photos". Route them to the "Incident Scene Photos & Videos" document section (see roadmap item for the new section).

title: Partial save at every stage of a claim
description: Ensure that at any stage a partially populated claim can be opened, any single detail – however small – edited, and saved, without being blocked by mandatory fields or mandatory documents.

title: Cannot save a single added document after questionnaire (Third-Party claim)
description: After the customer completes the questionnaire, entering Edit mode and adding one document (e.g. a consent form) does not allow updating the claim unless all other documents are provided. Mandatory-field and mandatory-document validations block small incremental updates in the Edit Claim window. Observed on a Third-Party claim – same root cause as the policy-claim partial-save issue discussed previously. Allow saving any single change.
notes: #1 · 17/11/26 10:00 · Aviv Ashkenazi: Same issue we discussed yesterday on the policy claim – partial progress cannot be saved in Edit Claim because of mandatory fields/documents. This case is a Third-Party claim.

title: Prevent data loss when a claim gets stuck
description: When a claim gets stuck (e.g. a large file upload or another failure), the claim must not be lost unsaved – auto-save a draft and recover gracefully.
source: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

title: Bafi pulls documents from the general folder instead of the claim folder
description: Reported live during a session with Randa (17.11.2026, 10:04): Bafi still pulls documents from the client's general documents folder instead of the Claims folder. In Bafi every client has a Claims folder with a sub-folder per claim containing its own documents – the import must target the specific claim folder.

title: Emotional distress & linkage interest in claim amounts
description: In the amounts section of the Edit Claim window, add "Emotional Distress" and "Linkage Interest" categories – tailored especially for attorneys.

title: Auto-detect and auto-fill the insurance company
description: Auto-populate the Insurance Company field from the notice-form data and the coverage check, so the user does not need to set it manually when it already exists.

title: Vehicle-identification guidance in the notice form
description: While filling in the notice form, show clear guidance on which vehicle is meant – the claimant's vehicle or the third party's vehicle.

title: Save draft at any stage of an agent claim
description: In agent claims, allow saving a draft at any stage of claim creation, even with minimal data.

title: Partner-user model (dual admin)
description: Add a partner-user option in which two users both hold admin permissions and all cases are fully visible and transparent to each other.

title: Total-loss vehicle claim calculation
description: For total-loss vehicles the system currently calculates by damage amount instead of vehicle value. The claim should equal the price-list value minus the salvage-value offset.

title: Damage report only (Form 68) – insurer's own customer
description: Allow submitting a damage report only (Form 68) for damage caused by the insurance company's own customer – not a policy claim, not a third-party claim and not an agent claim. No garage, appraiser or damage-location selection and no mandatory fields.

title: Policy notification only – third party hit, no own damage
description: Allow submitting a claim as a notification to the policy only, for cases where the insured hit a third party but has no damage of their own – without mandatory fields such as repairing garage, appraiser report, appraiser name, etc.

title: Smart one-click "Translate to Hebrew" button
description: Add a smart button that translates all on-screen content to Hebrew in a single click.

title: Separate the notes mechanism from reminders
description: Create a dedicated Notes button, display notes in the claim view card, and persist them so they do not disappear after re-login.

title: Reorder Claim View – communication history above documents
description: Move the communication-history section above the documents section in the Claim View window (higher priority).

title: New "Incident Scene Photos & Videos" document section
description: In Edit Claim, add a new document section named "Incident Scene Photos & Videos".

title: View linked documents in the built-in Outlook
description: In the built-in Outlook, allow viewing all documents linked to the claim when composing a new email.

title: Remember recipient addresses when sending from a claim
description: When sending an email from the claim row, remember previously used addresses (both To and CC).

title: Editable email subject when sending
description: When sending an email from the claim row, allow editing and changing the email subject.

title: Auto-capture insurer and handling garage
description: Automatically capture the insurance company from an uploaded form, and auto-fill the "Handling Garage" based on the logged-in user.

title: One-click Form 68 and non-filing generation
description: Generate Form 68 from the insurance companies in one click, and generate a non-filing declaration / send an automatic email to obtain it.

title: Harel, Securitas and automatic consent form
description: Add Harel to the garage-arrangement list, add Securitas to the coverage check, and automatically insert the consent form after signing.

title: Auto-extract the claim number from insurer emails
description: Automatically extract the claim number from the insurer's reply email and insert it into the claim card and the claims table.

title: Unsent-claim alert and reminder search by date
description: Show a prominent alert when a claim fails to be sent from the portal, and allow searching by date in the All Reminders screen.

title: Demand-letter preview from Edit Claim
description: Add a preview button for the demand letter inside the Edit Claim window, so the letter can be reviewed before sending.

title: Claim-specific note in the demand letter
description: Allow adding, from the claim window, a note to that claim's demand letter only – without changing the global letter template and without affecting demand letters of other claims.

title: "Days in treatment" component in the Garages report
description: Add a "Days in treatment" tracking component to the Garages report.

title: Lien-handling workflow (finance companies)
description: One-click request to the lienholder for a letter of intent approving the release of funds, including managing the correspondence with the lienholder.

title: Lien-release form for digital signature
description: Send the "Lien Release for Insurance Proceeds" form to the customer in one click, to be signed by the lienholder and returned to the agent.

title: Auto-fill the notice form from the WhatsApp questionnaire
description: Allow the WhatsApp questionnaire to automatically populate the notice form.

title: Non-filing declaration via the bot
description: If the WhatsApp bot receives an answer that the customer has no insurance, trigger a task to sign a non-filing declaration (attorney-verified).

title: Inbound/outbound communication report
description: Generate an inbound and outbound communication report per customer (for use if legal proceedings are opened).

title: Automatic total-loss detection
description: Automatically detect a total loss based on the depreciation percentages in the appraiser report.
source: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

title: Remember insurers and leasing companies entered under "Other"
description: Remember insurance companies added under the "Other" field (e.g. leasing companies) for re-use later.
source: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

title: Filter claims not yet sent to the insurer
description: Allow filtering by the status "not sent to insurer", with a warning icon similar to Shomera, Direct Insurance and Phoenix.
source: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

title: Per-user work allocation and action audit trail
description: For accounts where a whole team works on the same mailbox, enable allocation by user and a full audit trail of who opened the case, who edited it and further actions – for reporting.
source: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests

title: Duplicate a claim for a second insurer
description: Allow duplicating an existing claim in order to send it to a second insurance company when there are two third parties.
source: Dev Request Portal – Racheli Asraf requests
